newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arafat, Levy to meet EU foreign ministers.
newsitem.headline: Arafat, Levy to meet EU foreign ministers.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat will meet European Union foreign ministers on Tuesday in Brussels, according to a statement issued by the Luxembourg EU presidency.
An official from the Luxembourg presidency was unable to say whether Arafat would have direct talks with Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy, whose meeting with the ministers was already confirmed.
"A discussion is also foreseen with the President of the Palestine authority, Mr Yasser Arafat," the statement said.
Asked whether the two men central to the Middle East peace process would meet face to face, the official said: "That is not at all clear."

Both men will meet the ministers at the invitation of the Luxembourg EU presidency. The EU has been trying to broker talks between the two in a bid to restart the Middle East Peace process, stalled for four months.
EU ministers will be briefed on the situation in the Middle East by the bloc's special envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos.
An unidentified official from the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) told Reuters in Gaza earlier: "Arafat is most likely to meet Levy in Brussels."
Levy met top PLO negotiator Nabil Shaath in Jerusalem on Sunday as part of the EU peace bid.

Israeli-PLO talks, launched with a U.S.-backed interim accord in 1993, have been stuck since Israel started building a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March, triggering Palestinian protests.
